description: Cyber Grunge is an aesthetic that blends elements of Grunge , streetwear, and Y2K Futurism , sometimes with slight military influences. This style, which has been observed since approximately 2022, is characterized by bold silhouettes, utilitarian features, and an infusion of futuristic elements. It largely utilizes "subversive basics," referring to simple clothing with alternative or avant-garde details such as cut-outs, mesh, and pockets. The influence of the Y2K revival is also prevalent, with accessories, prints, and silhouettes from that era being common.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Urban edge, rebellious style, Y2K nostalgia, utilitarianism, societal critique, disillusionment

visualDNA.colour: Black, gray, muted greens, browns, and blues
